title: 第16章 出发了第17章 镖局被抢
slug: 凡人修仙我只是个路人甲
content_zh:
九月十六一大早，林鹤清就带着齐大夫，去了兴隆镖局。
一到镖局，林鹤清出示在镖局开的两张凭证，两辆车就被引导到一片空地，现在上面正有许多人和车在排队。
两人坐在里面，等外面吵吵嚷嚷大概有一个时辰以后，有镖师来确认人数了。
又大概过了一刻钟。
一个镖师来敲了敲车，林鹤清把帘子掀开。
“林公子”，是尚武的声音，“您的另一辆车就紧跟着在后面，这两辆车就由我和赵亮负责了，他在后面那辆车里，您看一眼。”
林鹤清下车看了一眼，肖强在赶马车，赵亮是个人高马壮的汉子，牵着一匹马，对着林鹤清抱了个拳，林鹤清回礼。
“行，您上去吧，我们马上就要出发了。
一天车队大概停下一次，如果路上需要如厕，我陪您两下去，车队是不停的，不然车队不好赶路呢。”尚武说道。
“我知道了，麻烦你们了。”林鹤清客气的说，路上还得依仗他们呢。
“您客气。”尚武回道。
林鹤清就上车了，慢慢的，车晃了起来，开始走了。
刚从南门离开良泉镇，走上官道，林鹤清就从里面掀开窗帘，好奇的往外看。
虽然来到这个世界七年了，林鹤清除了良泉镇还有张家村，哪里都没有去过。
虽然林鹤清一直待在良泉镇，但是他每天都把自己的时间排的满满的。
早上起来在院子里做点运动，这个是小时候从李府的教练那学来的，就学了一套动作。
他每天都会重复那套动作十遍，汗湿了衣服就去换下。
换好衣服以后，府里的人差不多就把早饭送过来了，林鹤清吃完以后，肖力和肖强两兄弟就在院门口等他出门了。
他在书店在这么多书里面先粗读一下，一开始读的很慢，一两天都读不完，不得不经常买些书，免得店小二把他赶出去。
一来二去的，各个书肆都熟了之后，就只买自己感兴趣的书，书肆大都不会得罪他。

现在他读书的速度已经很快了，每天不停地阅读，既打开了他的眼界，又锻炼了他的思维。
下午学习医术，从理论到实践，从认识药材到种植炮制药材，全不假手于人，每天都有新的收获。
晚上则要修炼，从一开始进入心无旁骛的状态要花一晚上到现在能够内视，真气循环将近一周，始终还差一点，但是他一直也没有放松过。
每天都如同机器人的几乎苛刻的作息时间，使得他每天都十分充实繁忙。
现在在马车上，突然闲了下来，十分不得劲。
看书在摇晃的马车上也不好看，练习针法也对不准，一上午过去，林鹤清感到有点无聊了。
齐大夫把林鹤清的状态看在眼里，没有说话，还不到时候。
中午，车队在一个宽阔的地面停了下来，林鹤清的两辆车在商队后面。
除了这两个商队的十二辆车以外，就林鹤清的两辆车最多了。
前面胡镖头在说话，林鹤清听不清说的什么，不过也不急，车边的镖师能看懂镖头的手势。
“林公子，镖头说，现在可以下来休息下，吃点干粮，就不要搭灶台了，半个时辰后就接着上路。”
content_en:
Early on the morning of September 16th, Lin Heqing took Dr. Qi to the Xinglong Escort Agency.
As soon as he arrived at the escort office, Lin Heqing showed the two vouchers issued at the escort office, and the two cars were guided to an open space where many people and cars were queuing up.
The two of them sat inside, and after about an hour of noise outside, an escort came to confirm the number of people.
About another quarter of an hour passed.
An escort came and knocked on the car, and Lin Heqing opened the curtain.
"Master Lin," was Shang Wu's voice, "Your other car is following closely behind. Zhao Liang and I will be in charge of these two cars. He is in the car behind. Take a look."
Lin Heqing got out of the car and took a look. Xiao Qiang was driving a carriage. Zhao Liang was a tall and strong man, leading a horse and gave Lin Heqing a fist. Lin Heqing returned the greeting.
"Okay, come on up, we're going to leave soon.
The convoy stops about once a day. If you need to go to the toilet on the way, I will accompany you twice. The convoy does not stop, otherwise it will be difficult for the convoy to move forward. "Shang Wu said.
"I understand, please excuse me." Lin Heqing said politely, he had to rely on them on the way.
"You're welcome." Shang Wu replied.
Lin Heqing got in the car. Slowly, the car started to shake and started to leave.
As soon as he left Liangquan Town through the south gate and walked onto the official road, Lin Heqing opened the curtains from inside and looked out curiously.
Although it has been seven years since he came to this world, Lin He has cleared out Liangquan Town and Zhangjia Village and has never been anywhere.
Although Lin Heqing has been staying in Liangquan Town, he has a full schedule every day.
Get up in the morning and do some exercise in the yard. I learned this from the coach of Li Mansion when I was a child. I learned a set of moves.
He would repeat the same set of actions ten times every day and change out of his clothes when they got wet with sweat.
After changing clothes, the people in the mansion almost brought breakfast over. After Lin Heqing finished eating, the two brothers Xiao Li and Xiao Qiang were waiting for him at the entrance of the courtyard before he left.
He read briefly among the many books in the bookstore. He read very slowly at first and couldn't finish them in a day or two. He had to buy more books frequently to prevent the waiter from kicking him out.
After going back and forth to each book store, he will only buy books that interest him, and most book stores will not offend him.
Now he reads very quickly. He reads constantly every day, which not only opens his horizons, but also exercises his thinking.
In the afternoon, I learned medical skills, from theory to practice, from understanding medicinal materials to planting and processing medicinal materials, all without relying on others, and there are new gains every day.
He had to practice in the evening. It took him one night to enter a state of mindlessness from the beginning until he was able to see inside. His true energy circulated for nearly a week, but he was still a little short of it, but he never relaxed.
He has an almost demanding schedule like a robot every day, making him very fulfilling and busy every day.
Now on the carriage, I suddenly became idle and felt very uncomfortable.
Reading on the rickety carriage was not good, and practicing acupuncture was not accurate. After a morning, Lin Heqing felt a little bored.
Doctor Qi saw Lin Heqing's condition in his eyes and said nothing as it was not time yet.
At noon, the convoy stopped on a wide ground, and Lin Heqing's two cars were behind the caravan.
Apart from the twelve cars of these two caravans, Lin Heqing's two cars were the most numerous.
The escort leader Hu was talking in front. Lin Heqing couldn't hear clearly what he said, but he was not in a hurry. The escort next to the car could understand the escort commander's gestures.
"Mr. Lin, the bodyguard said, now you can come down and rest, eat some solid food, and don't set up the stove. We will be on the road in half an hour."
